--- 

The Protection DC system design tool is rated as "Very important" (rating: 4) due to its critical role in the planning and implementation phases of medium-voltage direct current (MVDC) systems. As Europe advances towards deploying workable LV/MV-DC microgrids, ensuring that these systems are both safe and efficient becomes paramount. The tool aids designers by simulating protection schemes, which is essential for identifying potential issues before physical deployment. This preemptive approach not only enhances system reliability but also aligns with ongoing European standardization efforts, facilitating a smoother transition to DC technologies across various sectors. By providing comprehensive design capabilities, the Protection DC system design tool helps mitigate risks associated with DC microgrids and supports the broader goal of expanding DC infrastructure in Europe.
